stories.title: Ex-DeepMind researcher bets AlphaGo's approach can fix AI hallucinations
stories.summary: Former DeepMind researcher Thore Graepel is building Metis Reasoning, a startup applying AlphaGo's search principle and an explicit, checkable knowledge ledger to general AI reasoning, The Decoder reports.
stories.more: Graepel's approach would keep knowledge in an explicit ledger rather than locked inside model weights, making conclusions checkable against evidence, according to The Decoder. The idea borrows AlphaGo's search principle and applies it to general reasoning rather than a narrow game. The Decoder notes there is so far no working system and no benchmarks demonstrating the approach. It's unclear when Metis Reasoning might produce a testable prototype.

items.title: Former Deepmind researcher thinks AlphaGo's playbook can cure AI hallucinations
items.excerpt: Former Deepmind researcher Thore Graepel wants his startup Metis Reasoning to bring AlphaGo's search principle to general reasoning. Instead of locking knowledge inside model weights, an explicit knowledge ledger would make every conclusion checkable against evidence. So far, though, there's no working system and no benchmarks. The article Former Deepmind researcher thinks AlphaGo's playbook can cure AI hallucinations appeared first on The Decoder .

stories.title: OpenAI has outside experts verify AI-generated math and physics proofs
stories.summary: OpenAI says its internal models solved three major open problems in math, computer science, and physics, and it's having outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, verify the proofs, The Decoder reports.
stories.more: One of the solved problems is part of a Millennium Prize Problem, which carries a $1 million prize, according to The Decoder. OpenAI is having outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, check whether the proofs hold up. The Decoder notes that if the computer science proof is verified, hundreds of existing research papers would lose their foundation. It's not yet known when the outside review will conclude.

stories.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel departs for Microsoft Office rival
stories.summary: Rohit Patel, a Meta AI director for eight years, is leaving to grow his startup Ndoc, which aims to compete with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, TechCrunch reports.
stories.more: Patel worked at Meta for eight years on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, according to TechCrunch. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on the Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace. TechCrunch reported the departure as an exclusive. stories.title: DeepMind launches Genie 4, a more realistic world simulation model
stories.summary: Google DeepMind released Genie 4, a world model that generates real-time interactive simulations with audio, more realistic physics and people, and mid-simulation text prompts. It's in research preview for trusted testers.
stories.more: Genie 4 adds real-time audio, more realistic worlds and people, and lets users steer a simulation mid-run with a natural-language prompt. According to TechCrunch, the model uses Gemini 3.8 Flash under the hood. DeepMind is currently offering it only to trusted testers in a research preview. Ars Technica reports it will roll out to developers and Google AI Ultra subscribers soon. It's not yet clear when a wider release will happen.
